notes.title: V.1.4
notes.notes:
V.1.4. is now live and contains a new classic cheat code system 
that give players more control of the way they want to experience Toey Weedz Smoke One!
With classics like infinite health or a coinz cheat, Toey Weedz Smoke One is now gettin fun for everyone!
Also all achievements are still unlockable while using cheatcodes, so dont worry about using them.
The list of cheatcodes and how to use them can be found in the "community guides":

The update is bringing you new weapondraw animations for all regular guns too!

- New Cheatcodesystem
- New weapondraw animations for all regular guns
- Improved gameplayexperience
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079191/f70a7ce6a08ac6d02824fa9572bc75c14a5e6051.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix v.1.3
notes.notes:
- Battery in the milkfactory is now switchable (Level1)
- Aiming with the sniperrifle should now deactivate the hud as supposed to
- Bottles are now marked with an arrow for better visibility
- There is now a deadzone under level1 
(just in case if you fly through the map due to individual unknown collision bugs for no reason, Toey Weedz should atleast die now) still working on a fixx
- new sounds if you view the map
- reduced loading times for level2
- improved gameplayexperience (smoother gameplay, less collisionbugs, more stable framerate)
- New Event in level3: Ufo crash
- New gameplay mechanic: Ray gun is now locked till finding a blueprint on the ufo crashsite

Thanks to the player feedback, this patch is coming out faster than expected, its fixxing some 
problems and is also improving the gameplay experience for better accessibility 
and more fun in Toey Weedz Smoke One!

Happy Gaming and keep helping Toey Weedz Free the World of D!s
